description:
Implement maintenance operations (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE equivalents) for DataFrame
platforms, enabling full TPC-H and TPC-DS compliance in DataFrame mode.

Currently, `get_maintenance_operations_sql()` only supports SQL mode. When users
run `--platform polars-df --benchmark tpch --phases maintenance`, no error is raised
and the maintenance phase silently does nothing useful.

DataFrame platforms like Spark (Delta Lake, Iceberg), Polars, and others support
write operations that can implement TPC maintenance semantics:
- Delta Lake: MERGE, UPDATE, DELETE operations
- Iceberg: Row-level deletes, upserts
- Polars: write_parquet() with append/overwrite modes
- Parquet files: Partition-based updates

This work involves:
1. Adding validation to error when maintenance+dataframe is attempted (short-term fix)
2. Designing a unified maintenance abstraction that works for both SQL and DataFrame
3. Implementing platform-specific maintenance operations
